title: Wave Echo Cave · Area 1 · Cave entrance

sourceRecords.title: Arrival · follow a route the party actually earned
read: The foothills close around the trail. Ahead, a dark opening cuts beneath the rock. Cold air brushes past you, and from somewhere below comes a low crash, like surf heard through the earth.

The opening offers a visible threshold, but the sound beyond it reaches farther than your sight. The rocky approach gives you a place to check equipment and gather your light before entering. You can study the ground, agree on your order, or listen for the next distant surge.

sourceRecords.title: Area 1 · Rockseeker camp and the descent
read: Three bedrolls surround a silent camp. Supplies lie where their owners left them. A dwarf’s body rests among the bundles, and a rope tied around a stone spire drops into a break in the cavern floor.

The rope is the clearest connection between this camp and the space below. Its fastening and the edge of the pit can be examined before anyone descends. The bundles and the body offer separate questions, and you can leave room for someone to keep watch while the others decide where to begin.
